decisive_items: Showed positive reactivity to melanocytic markers HMB45, MITF2, and Melan-A
Revealed a solid tumor with an inflamed crust on its surface, composed of large anaplastic cells with mitotic activity
response.rationale: R4 precisely identifies the tumor as malignant melanoma of the caruncle, directly matching the location and histopathologic/IHC evidence. R5 is similar but less formal; R1 is too general, R3 misses the caruncular specificity, and R2 overemphasizes anaplasia without location.

rejected.why: Too broad; lacks the specific caruncular location.
Conjunctival melanoma is less specific than caruncular melanoma, and the vignette explicitly notes absence of PAM.
Anaplastic melanoma is not a standard distinct diagnosis and omits the caruncular origin.
Caruncular melanoma is similar but less precise than malignant melanoma of the caruncle.
